headline: Solid profitability; prior-period comparisons unavailable
summary_short: BorgWarner posted Q2 FY2026 revenue of $3,648M and net income of $277M; q/q and y/y comparisons are omitted because the shard's prior-period figures are corrupted by an unrelated-company data mixup.
summary_long: Q2 FY2026: revenue $3,648M, gross profit $721M (19.8% margin), operating income $390M (10.7% margin), EBITDA $546M (15.0% margin), net income $277M (7.6% margin). EPS was $1.36 basic and $1.34 diluted. Quarter-over-quarter and year-over-year comparisons are omitted: the shard's prior-period actuals for this ticker are contaminated by an unrelated company's data (see confidence_notes).
